scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && node scripts/package-library.mjs && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @btdesign/tokens && npm run build -w @btdesign/react && npm run build -w @btdesign/vue && npm run build -w @btdesign/core
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @btdesign/api && node scripts/package-library.mjs && npm run build -w @btdesign/docs
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @btdesign/tokens && npm run test -w @btdesign/react && npm run test -w @btdesign/vue && npm run test -w @btdesign/core && npm run test -w @btdesign/api && node --test scripts/migrate-audit.test.mjs && node --import tsx --test apps/docs/test/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @btdesign/docs
